sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Blocky Squirrel is an endless runner game, where the player controls a blocky squirrel as it navigates through a procedurally generated course. The game's simplicity lies in its controls, which are easy to pick up but difficult to master. The player must use the left and right arrow keys or the mouse to move the squirrel left and right, while using the space bar or the jump button to make the squirrel jump.

The game's procedurally generated course means that each time you play, you'll encounter a new and unique set of obstacles and challenges. The course is divided into different levels, each with its own set of obstacles and challenges. As you progress through the levels, the obstacles become increasingly difficult to overcome, requiring the player to use their reflexes and strategic thinking to succeed.

One of the key features of Blocky Squirrel is its emphasis on timing and spatial awareness. The player must time their jumps perfectly to avoid obstacles, and use their spatial awareness to navigate through tight spaces. This requires a high level of concentration and focus, making the game challenging and rewarding for players who are able to master it.

Overall, the gameplay mechanics of Blocky Squirrel are simple yet complex, making it a game that is easy to learn but difficult to master. The game's procedurally generated course and emphasis on timing and spatial awareness ensure that each playthrough is unique and challenging, providing endless replayability for players of all ages and skill levels.
